items_flat.title_en: Anthropic Updates Fable 5 Biology Safeguards, Cutting False Positives ~85%
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic 更新 Fable 5 生物學安全防護，誤報大幅減少約85%
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic announced updates to Claude Fable 5’s biology safeguards that substantially reduce false positives. In testing the change cut biology-related fallbacks by about 85% across product surfaces, letting the model assist more with everyday health, educational and clinical questions while still routing dual-use requests (virology, toxicology, molecular design) to Opus 5.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic 宣布更新 Claude Fable 5 的生物學安全防護，大幅減少誤報。測試顯示各產品介面的生物學相關退回情況減少約85%，讓模型能更廣泛協助日常健康、教育與臨床問題，同時仍將雙重用途請求（病毒學、毒理學、分子設計）路由至 Opus 5。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a practical safety-tuning step that expands useful access for researchers and clinicians without removing the core dual-use barrier. It underscores the ongoing tension between capability openness and catastrophic bio-risk mitigation; trusted-access pathways remain the stated longer-term solution.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是實用的安全調校步驟，擴大研究人員與臨床人員的可用範圍，但未移除核心雙重用途屏障。它凸顯能力開放與災難性生物風險緩解之間的持續張力；可信賴存取途徑仍是官方長期解決方案。
items_flat.quote: We’re making updates to Claude Fable 5’s biology safeguards in a way that substantially reduces false positives. In our testing, this update reduced fallbacks by about 85% across our product surfaces.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們正在以大幅減少誤報的方式更新 Claude Fable 5 的生物學安全防護。在測試中，此更新使各產品介面的退回情況減少約85%。

items_flat.title_en: xAI Releases Grok Build V1.0 Terminal Coding Agent
items_flat.title_zh: xAI 發布 Grok Build V1.0 終端編碼代理
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk announced that Grok Build has reached V1.0.0, the first major release of xAI’s terminal coding agent powered by Grok 4.5. The update adds dashboard turn summaries, improved permissions and reliability, skills/plugins support, parallel subagents and numerous UX fixes after rapid 0.x iteration.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk 宣布 Grok Build 達到 V1.0.0，這是 xAI 由 Grok 4.5 驅動的終端編碼代理首個主要版本。更新新增儀表板回合摘要、改進權限與可靠性、技能/插件支援、平行子代理，以及多次 0.x 快速迭代後的眾多 UX 修復。
items_flat.analysis_en: Coding agents are rapidly becoming a primary interface for frontier models. Hitting 1.0 after intensive shipping shows product maturity in a competitive field, yet sustained differentiation against Claude Code, Codex and Muse Code remains an open question.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 編碼代理正快速成為前沿模型的主要介面。密集出貨後達到 1.0 顯示產品在競爭激烈賽道的成熟度，但與 Claude Code、Codex 及 Muse Code 的長期差異化仍是未解問題。
items_flat.quote: Grok Build V1.0 is now released. Try it out! https://x.ai/build
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Build V1.0 現已發布。快來試試！https://x.ai/build

brief_en: Quiet early Aug 8 (Taipei): Anthropic refined Claude Fable 5 biology safeguards, cutting false-positive fallbacks ~85% while keeping dual-use blocks; xAI shipped Grok Build V1.0 terminal coding agent powered by Grok 4.5. No new foundation model releases in the window.
brief_zh: 8月8日開局平靜：Anthropic 改進 Claude Fable 5 生物學安全防護，誤報退回減少約85%並保留雙重用途封鎖；xAI 推出由 Grok 4.5 驅動的 Grok Build V1.0 終端編碼代理。窗口內無新基礎模型發布。
